reflection: The notebook shows the 3-day Apple-vs-peer gap family helps in 2022, 2023 and 2025 but fails in 2024, the trending low-vol year. Most one-day Apple candle patterns and QQQ-only state factors flip sign in 2024. Scaled variants that stay close to the parent (volume weighting, vol scaling) are near-copies, so I need to change the information, not just the scaling. This round I try to fix 2024 by conditioning on persistence of the trend (peer gap sign agreeing with the 20d trend), a longer-window peer gap using MSFT only, and new overnight and volume-based ideas that stay within the nesting limit of 6.

lessons.name: aapl_peer_gap_trend_filtered
lessons.lesson: Multiplying the peer gap by the sign of the QQQ 20d trend threw away magnitude information and flipped the effect by year, so it helped only in 2023.

lessons.name: aapl_peer_gap_10d_vol_ratio
lessons.lesson: A 10-day peer gap is too slow and scaling by Apple's own vol ratio added noise, so it helped only in 2025.

lessons.name: peer_overnight_gap_mean
lessons.lesson: The formula was nested deeper than 6, so overnight gap ideas must be written with fewer layers.

lessons.name: aapl_intraday_vs_qqq_intraday
lessons.lesson: Intraday Apple-vs-QQQ return is largely a copy of AAPL_minus_QQQ_1d and only helped LR, adding nothing for the team.

lessons.name: aapl_volume_weighted_peer_gap
lessons.lesson: The volume ratio multiplier barely changed the peer gap (0.98 similarity), so it was a near-copy that inherited the 2024 failure.

lessons.name: nvda_msft_spread_qqq_vol_state
lessons.lesson: Scaling the NVDA-MSFT spread by a QQQ vol ratio left it nearly unchanged (0.99), so it was a duplicate.

factors.name: aapl_peer_gap_5d_regime_interaction
factors.hypothesis: The parent failed in 2024 when vol was low and stable; using a 2-day gap and a 3/60 vol ratio makes the regime scale more extreme in calm periods and shrinks the signal there, which should reduce the 2024 damage.

factors.name: aapl_msft_gap_trend_agree
factors.hypothesis: The peer gap failed in 2024 where relative moves persisted; multiplying the short gap by the 20d relative trend vs MSFT encodes whether the short gap continues or reverses the longer relative trend, and uses only the most similar peer.

factors.name: aapl_overnight_vs_qqq_overnight
factors.hypothesis: Apple's overnight gap relative to the QQQ gap removes the market-wide component that made the raw gap regime dependent, leaving Apple-specific overnight sentiment.

factors.name: aapl_down_volume_pressure
factors.hypothesis: A 5-day volume-weighted return captures whether volume accompanied up or down moves, a smoother pattern than the single-day signed volume which failed as a copy of the return.

factors.name: qqq_range_vs_aapl_range_gap
factors.formula: subtract(safe_divide(subtract(AAPL_High, AAPL_Low), rolling_mean(subtract(AAPL_High, AAPL_Low), 20)), safe_divide(subtract(QQQ_High, QQQ_Low), rolling_mean(subtract(QQQ_High, QQQ_Low), 20)))
factors.hypothesis: Complements the volume-activity market factor with Apple's range expansion relative to QQQ's range expansion, flagging Apple-specific stress days that interact with NVDA/QQQ activity.

factors.name: nvda_msft_spread_apple_gap_product
factors.hypothesis: The NVDA-MSFT spread worked mainly in 2025 AI-leadership regimes; signing it by whether Apple is lagging or leading QQQ tells the model whether Apple is likely to catch up to the leadership move.
